title: Pulmonary Services Group
description: pulmonaryservicesgrouppr.com zoominfo.com/c/pulmonary-services-group/442368923 Pulmonary Services Group (Medicare-enrolled since 1998, pulmonaryservicesgrouppr.com, Santurce/San Juan + Mayagüez, Puerto Rico) is a three-company group — Respiratory Equipment Leasing and Sales Services Corp., Mayagüez Alquiler y Venta, and Pulmonary Equipment Corp — providing home medical equipment and respiratory therapy services across the island and hospital equipment distribution to Puerto Rico and the Caribbean. Its specialty is home mechanical ventilation for ventilator-dependent patients (neonates to elderly), plus CPAP/BiPAP for sleep apnea, oxygen concentrators, speaking valves, enteral feeding and home-care gear (hospital beds, lifts, mattresses). The company holds JCAHO accreditation since 1998 in respiratory therapy and durable medical equipment, accepts Medicare and most local health plans, and offers 24/7 delivery, installation, training and technical support.
